title: Emerging Artist Beamco is currently making waves with the release of his recent song "Whatever You Got"
htmlContent:
Canadian music star, Beamco is a talented singer and songwriter poised to make waves in the scene with his exceptional sound and style. He is well known for making alternative, emo-influenced R&B music and does not disappoint in releasing his latest track, "Whatever you Got."

In his recent song "Whatever You Got," Beamco talked about all the life-changing epiphanies he encountered while returning to his everyday life from the hospital. The vision and feeling the music evokes make people fall in love with music. The magic of it makes it an authentic experience you don't want to miss or ever want to end.
